content.short: Eventpop is a Thai event ticketing and management platform with a mini app in World App.
content.description: Eventpop is an end-to-end event platform from Thailand, selling tickets for concerts, fan events and festivals and giving organisers tools to run them. It is listed in World's official ecosystem directory as a mini app inside World App, where verified humans can use it.
